GREEN SHOE GARAGE · INTERFACEBENCH 1.4.3-rc.1

A much bigger parts bench.

Physical interface planning, from a 3 mm indicator to a 120 mm fan opening. Browse the exact catalog bundled with this release.

267total components
255new templates
14categories

Planning templates require measurement. 265 definitions are generic; 2 retain manufacturer-source evidence. Generic dimensions, holes, terminal identities and ratings are unverified. Connector-family names indicate intended use, not a certified footprint.

Pushbuttons · 23Switches & selectors · 23Knobs & rotary controls · 17Faders & joysticks · 12Indicators & sound · 18Displays & meters · 21Audio & coax connectors · 19Data & multipin connectors · 35Power & protection · 16Sensors & apertures · 14Cable entry & routing · 16Fasteners & mounting · 26Fans & ventilation · 15Board & module carriers · 12

What changed

Category and source filters, word-based search, saved favorites, dimension details before placement, and editable custom categories/tags make the larger library practical. Browsing shows 24 results at a time and preserves filters when you place a component.

64 automated checks pass. Every definition validates, embeds independently, round-trips through project JSON and exports its openings. Generic cut patterns are checked for internal overlap and containment. Complex patterns also pass PDF and frozen-ZIP export checks.

Release candidate: actual browser layout, pointer/keyboard behavior, persistence and offline/update acceptance remain unverified. The Sites skill requires skipping browser QA when its supported browser-control skill is unavailable and forbids a substitute browser path. This report is a generated catalog reference, not a browser screenshot or a physical measurement report.

Complex connectors, sensors and modules supply geometry and wiring documentation only. P-number terminals are placeholders; passive 0 V means unspecified. Existing interaction models support simple controls and readouts, not circuit simulation.
